midpoint.scan_time_basis: archive generated_utc; program start or completion, not exact quote acquisition
midpoint.selection: earliest usable pre-kickoff scan per canonical fixture; no error-based selection

gate_e.reason: separate timestamp-qualified market archive evaluation required

protocol.baseline: Poisson lambda from mean home/away xG over identical permitted expanding training rows; rho=0
protocol.prior_seasons: only actual complete seasons; no fabricated prior block
protocol.production: unchanged ten variants, raw per-outcome medians retained; renormalization only for categorical scoring
protocol.promotion_status: not certified; prospective two complete matchweeks and predeclared out-of-time evidence remain required
protocol.rounds: train complete official prefix 1..k; predict full official round k+1 before earliest source kickoff
protocol.selection: nested prior 1X2 logloss; 120/8 predeclared fallback below two inner folds
protocol.totals_aggregation: equal-weight per-fixture mean of three binary log losses
